request.instructions:
You audit the close of a design session for 3D printing in OpenSCAD. The harness verified the final version of the design and gives you, in JSON, what it measured (VERIFIED) and the spec adjustments it detected: changes of the spec towards what the mesh already measured, without the part changing (ADJUSTMENTS). Read the designer's CLOSE and answer only with a JSON object, with no text before or after it:
{"unsupported": [{"claim": "...", "reason": "..."}], "untold_adjustments": [{"adjustment": "...", "reason": "..."}]}
- unsupported: every claim the close presents as verified (measured, checked, that it meets, that it fits, that it does not collide, that it goes in, that it prints without supports) that VERIFIED does not back: it is not there, it says something else or the numbers do not match. Leave out: what the close states as not verified, an opinion, an intention, or a description of the design that does not claim to have been checked.
- untold_adjustments: every part of ADJUSTMENTS whose adjustments the close does not mention with their reason (one mention per part saying what was adjusted and why is enough).
Empty lists if there is nothing to object to. Be precise: quote the claim as it is written.

ADJUSTMENTS
- assembly: interference jar / lid from not declared to permitted (lug tips press 0.2mm (0.24 measured) against the detent bumps in the locked seat), the mesh measures 2.828 mm³, 0.239 mm thick (the overlap was already there and the geometry did not remove it)

CLOSE
Done — a two-part desk jar in `model.scad` (`part = jar / lid / assembly`, default shows the closed assembly).

**Design.** Jar: 77 mm outside, cavity 70 mm across × 80 mm deep (floor at 2.4 mm, cavity floor-to-rim exactly 80), neck with three bayonet L-slots (vertical entries open at the rim, 102°-long grooves), and a detent bump at the end of each groove. Lid: prints upside-down on its closed top face, skirt (2.4 mm wall) with three inward lugs and shallow grip flutes that stay inside the 38.5 mm radius, so when closed it is flush with the jar body — total closed height 85.4 mm. Lugs run with 0.5 mm radial and 0.7 mm axial clearance; at the locked seat each lug presses 0.24 mm against its detent bump, which is what holds the lid against drifting open. Everything has fillets/chamfers (2–3 mm), no sharp corners. To use: drop the lugs into the entries, turn a quarter turn until you feel the detent click.

**Verified** (final exports + interference check, all green):
- Jar mesh: watertight, 1 body, 0 bad edges, bounds 77×77×82.4 [[jar]]; walls/floor measured [[jar/body_wall]] 3.5 mm, [[jar/neck_wall]] 3.0 mm, [[jar/floor]] 2.4 mm (all ≥ 1.6), cavity void [[jar/cavity]], groove [[jar/bayonet_slot]] and entry [[jar/entry_slot]] empty as specified, detent [[jar/detent_bump]] present and seen up close [[jar/detent_bump_view]], rim fillet [[jar/rim_soft]], bed face [[jar/bottom]] 4182 mm².
- Lid mesh: watertight, 1 body, bounds 77×77×16.8 [[lid]]; [[lid/skirt_wall]] and [[lid/top_wall]] 2.4 mm, lugs [[lid/lug]] present and seen close [[lid/lug_view]], flutes [[lid/grip_flutes]], bed face [[lid/top_face]] 4298 mm².
- No supports on an A1: jar overhangs only inside the declared groove-bridging zone plus the 45° shoulder ring, lid only its lug chamfers [[G5]].
- Assembly: instances congruent with the parts, one group, bounds 77×77×85.4 and desk face [[assembly/desk]] [[assembly]]; the quarter-turn motion sweeps collision-free except the declared detent flex [[bayonet_lock_turn]], and the lid drops on and turns into place in the declared order [[assembly_order]].

**Not verified:** real PETG behaviour — whether the 0.24 mm detent press gives the click you want and survives repeated use, and whether the modelled 0.5/0.7 mm clearances suit your printer's calibration (PETG varies; scale the lid 101 % if the first print binds). Strength, sealing, and looks are also unmeasured.

**Spec adjustments to disclose:** I corrected the neck-wall spec to the true 3.0 mm after fixing a rim-fillet centring error (wall is above the 1.6 mm minimum either way); moved/shrunk the detent and slot measurement boxes when the bump was relocated to the groove's locked end; added the three overhang zones above; and declared the locked-seat lug–bump press (2.83 mm³, 0.24 mm thick) as an allowed interference rather than removing it, because that press *is* the requested "bump holds the lid" feature, within the 0.3 mm press-fit allowance.
